editorial.blurb: A neighborhood gem where creative sushi rolls and vibrant Thai curries come together with genuine hospitality that makes you feel like family.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask the owner for a recommendation on your first visit—she'll guide you to perfect choices and remember your order next time. Don't miss the Smashing Pumpkins roll, and note that they're BYOB with a corner store nearby if you want to bring wine.
